benefits: Project funding from EUR 500,000 up to a maximum of EUR 1,000,000 for a period of five years
An additional EUR 200,000 tenure package for women ASTRA principal investigators who are granted a permanent position within the first three years of the project term

eligibility: Successful, internationally visible researchers from all disciplines, including arts-based research, who already have experience with independent research work (R3 level)
The applicant must have the academic qualifications needed to lead the proposed research project
Doctoral degree awarded at least 2 and not more than 9 years prior to 30 September of the year of submission (exceptions such as parental leave are defined in the Application Guidelines)
In arts-based research, researchers without a doctorate may apply with proof of at least 2 to a maximum of 9 years of relevant experience according to international standards
Individuals who already hold a tenured professorship or an equivalent leadership position, or have already accepted such an appointment, are not eligible
Researchers can apply to the ASTRA programme a maximum of two times throughout their career and serve as principal investigator in only one approved project
All Austrian research institutions are eligible to apply; the project must be carried out in Austria

All forms must be completed online and all documents uploaded in full before institutional approval

official.description: Launched in July 2024, the FWF ASTRA Awards are a career funding programme that gives advanced postdocs in Austria the opportunity to make the leap to the top of their research field, offering the conditions to conduct long-term research projects at a top international level and to acquire the qualifications needed for academic leadership positions.
official.program_type: Career award for advanced postdocs (principal investigator project)

applicant_utility.summary: ASTRA is the FWF's flagship five-year, EUR 500,000 to EUR 1,000,000 career award for researchers 2 to 9 years past their doctorate who already show R3-level independence, and it ends in a hearing before an international jury rather than a desk decision. Women applicants have two structural incentives: half of the awards are reserved for them, and the EUR 200,000 tenure package attaches if a permanent position is secured within the first three years. A missed ASTRA is not a wasted cycle - shortlisted candidates who present at the hearing are automatically funded as three-year PI projects of up to EUR 450,000, which is why the alternative project plan must be prepared as seriously as the main proposal.
applicant_utility.best_fit: Internationally visible researchers a few years past their doctorate who can evidence third-party funding, a research stay abroad or independent publications, and who have an Austrian institution ready to back a leadership bid.
application_readiness_checklist: Verify the doctorate date against the submission year's 30 September cut-off (2 to 9 years) and document any parental leave with the career-break forms before drafting
Count your career: two ASTRA applications per career are allowed, but only one approved PI project, so do not burn an attempt on an unfinished profile
Write the 2-page alternative project plan in full, including a cost breakdown that would work within EUR 450,000 over three years
Check your institution's application count against the Guidelines on the Maximum Number of ASTRA Applications before requesting PROFI approval
common_rejection_risks: Already holding or having accepted a tenured professorship or equivalent leadership position - an explicit exclusion
Applying through an institution that is already over its recommended application cap, so the proposal never reaches the jury in a strong state
Treating the alternative project plan as a formality: it is the Merit Award fallback and is reviewed too
Weak evidence of independence - reviewers look for post-doc third-party funding, foreign research experience or papers without the supervisor
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: The award covers project costs up to the approved sum over five years; school fees, relocation and personal living arrangements beyond the project budget are the applicant's responsibility.
document_audit: The alternative project plan has a hard 2-page limit including cost breakdown - overflowing pages are an easy own goal
Career breaks must be accounted for with the dedicated information sheet, checklist and form, or the jury may miscalculate your effective experience window
Clinical research needs a positive ethics commission opinion attached where applicable
PROFI mode means the host institution must approve the file before submission - start the internal approval chain early
alerts: Submissions are only possible during the published window, and the page currently shows 'Currently no submissions' - watch the FWF news feed for the June announcement
Half of the awards go to women, and women also receive the tenure package and additional measures such as career coaching
About 18 award winners per call means the odds are tight; the Merit Award fallback is the realistic floor for strong hearing candidates
2026 saw its awards announced at Austrian Science Awards ceremony - planning the final months of any incompatibility (e.g. a tenured appointment) matters before applying
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: Wait for the published window, assemble the abstract, project, alternative plan, templates and checklist, obtain host approval in elane under PROFI mode, then present before the international jury at the hearing.
